product_metadata.title: Aluan Wine Bottle Lights 10 Pack 12LED Cork Bottle Lights with Screwdriver Battery Operated Wine Cork Lights String Lights for Party Wedding Christmas Halloween Bar Jar Lamp Decor, Cool White
features: 【Perfect decoration】The wine bottle lights is an awesome way to recycle empty wine bottles, universal for any kind of bottles. The bright cool white glow create a fairy and romantic atmosphere, ideal for birthday parties, wedding, barbecue, Halloween, Christmas, New Year or other occasions that need romantic and dreamy ambience.

【High quality】 Premium silver made wire is anti- tangle and will not easily break off, thin, flexible and bendable that is easy to DIY any shape, can perfectly fit in bottles or wrap around plants, window, railing, fence, shelf, balcony, furniture, etc. Rice-sized fairy LED light beads are attached to the copper wire tightly, low consumption, no overheat and still safe to touch even after long time using, no risk of fire.

【Battery powered】 It has pre- installed 3 PCS LR44 in each string lights, they will keep super bright for 24 hours and run for 5 days before battery die. You can use the included screwdriver to change batteries, the LED bottle lights can be reused for many times. There's no need to find power source, just turn the lights on and put it anywhere, super convenient to use.

【Cork design】The diameter of the cork is from 1.6cm/ 0.6in to 2.3cm/ 0.9in, which is the universal size for most wine bottles, fit for most glass, wine, beer, soda, whiskey bottles and any other kind of bottles. Toggle the buttorn on the cork to turn the lights on/off, pretty easy to operate.

【Length detail】 The Aluan bottle lights is 1.2m/ 47ft long, 10 strands in 1 pack, each strand has 12 cool white LED beads in total, space between per LED: 10cm/ 4in. The 12 LED lights are bright enough for illumination and decoration, but will not flash to your eyes, ideal for indoor & outdoor using.
